You take part in QUARE Phase 2, a dialectical negotiation among five quality-specialized
agents (SafetyAgent, EfficiencyAgent, GreenAgent, TrustworthinessAgent, ResponsibilityAgent)
about the initial requirements of a software project. The negotiation runs in rounds; in each
round every agent speaks once and sees everything said before. Each turn follows the dialectical
structure: defend your thesis (your own requirements), raise antitheses (critiques of other
agents' requirements that undermine your quality dimension) and propose syntheses (merges,
decompositions, relaxed thresholds) that satisfy several constraints at once.

Conflict types: "resource" (qualities compete for finite resources, e.g. redundancy vs. energy),
"logical" (requirements impose mutually exclusive system states) or "redundant" (same intent).

Rules: refer to requirements only by their IDs; be concrete; keep "statement" under 120 words.
Always answer with a single JSON object with this schema:
{"statement": "your argument",
 "conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["ID", "ID"], "type": "resource|logical|redundant", "description": "..."}],
 "positions": [{"id": "ID", "stance": "support|oppose|modify", "proposal": "change you propose or empty"}],
 "concessions": ["IDs of your OWN requirements you agree to relax or drop"],
 "agree_to_close": true or false}
Set "agree_to_close" to true only if you have no remaining objections.

PROJECT: ATM - Automated Teller Machine System

PROJECT DESCRIPTION:
The bank client must be able to deposit an amount to and withdraw an amount from his or her accounts using the bank application. Each transaction must be recorded, and the client must have the ability to review all transactions performed against a given account. Recorded transactions must include the date, time, transaction type, amount and account balance after the transaction.

A bank client can have two types of accounts. A checking-account and a saving-account. For each checking account, one related saving-account can exists. The application must verify that a client can gain access to his or her account by identification via a personal identification number (PIN) code.

Neither a checking-account nor a saving-account can have a negative balance. The application should automatically withdraw funds from a related saving-account if the requested withdrawal amount on the checking-account is more than its current balance. If the saving-account balance is insufficient to cover the requested withdrawal amount, the application should inform the user and terminate the transaction.

INITIAL REQUIREMENTS (Phase 1):
[SafetyAgent]
SAF-01 (tactical): The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance.
SAF-02 (tactical): The system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving account if the checking account balance is insufficient.
SAF-03 (operational): The system shall inform the user and terminate the transaction if the saving account balance is insufficient for the withdrawal.
SAF-04 (operational): The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
SAF-05 (tactical): The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
SAF-06 (strategic): The system shall provide a mechanism for safe degradation by allowing limited withdrawals during system maintenance.
SAF-07 (operational): The system shall provide users with a clear summary of account status after each transaction.
[EfficiencyAgent]
EFF-01 (operational): The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.
EFF-02 (tactical): The system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
EFF-03 (tactical): The ATM application shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.
EFF-04 (operational): The system shall ensure that no account can enter a negative balance during transactions.
EFF-05 (operational): The ATM shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving-account without user delay.
EFF-06 (operational): The system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
EFF-07 (tactical): The ATM system shall implement load balancing to manage transaction requests effectively.
[GreenAgent]
GRN-01 (tactical): The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing to reduce idle states.
GRN-02 (operational): The ATM system shall provide a carbon footprint report for each transaction executed.
GRN-03 (tactical): The ATM system shall utilize energy-efficient hardware components to operate.
GRN-04 (operational): The ATM system shall ensure that all recorded transactions are logged in a way that minimizes data storage requirements.
GRN-05 (operational): The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
GRN-06 (tactical): The ATM system shall automatically shut down during periods of inactivity to save energy.
GRN-07 (strategic): The ATM system shall assess the environmental impact of its operations annually and report findings to stakeholders.
[TrustworthinessAgent]
TRU-01 (tactical): The system shall ensure that all transactions are encrypted during transmission.
TRU-02 (tactical): The system shall implement user authentication using a secure PIN code mechanism.
TRU-03 (operational): The system shall log all transactions along with their timestamps for audit purposes.
TRU-04 (tactical): The system shall prevent transactions that would result in negative account balances.
TRU-05 (operational): The system shall provide a mechanism for users to review their transaction history securely.
TRU-06 (operational): The system shall automatically notify users of insufficient funds before processing withdrawals.
TRU-07 (tactical): The system shall maintain data integrity by validating all account operations against business rules.
[ResponsibilityAgent]
RES-01 (strategic): The system shall ensure all transactions comply with applicable financial regulations and standards.
RES-02 (tactical): The application shall provide transaction logs that include date, time, type, amount, and updated balance.
RES-03 (tactical): The system shall prevent users from executing transactions that would create negative account balances.
RES-04 (tactical): The application shall validate user identity through a secure PIN entry mechanism.
RES-05 (operational): The system shall automatically withdraw funds from a related savings account only when sufficient funds are available.
RES-06 (operational): The application shall notify users immediately if a transaction cannot be completed due to insufficient funds.
RES-07 (strategic): The system shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.

NEGOTIATION TRANSCRIPT SO FAR:
[Round 1] SafetyAgent: Safety is paramount in the ATM system to protect users and their funds. Requirements SAF-01 and SAF-03 ensure that users cannot incur negative balances and are informed of insufficient funds, which mitigates financial hazards. SAF-04 provides transaction logging for accountability, while SAF-05 secures user authentication to prevent unauthorized access. Additionally, SAF-06 enables safe degradation during maintenance, ensuring continued service. SAF-07 enhances user awareness of account status, promoting informed decision-making.
{"conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["EFF-04", "TRU-04", "RES-03"], "type": "redundant", "description": "These requirements aim to prevent negative account balances, which overlaps with SAF-01."}, {"ids": ["EFF-05", "SAF-02"], "type": "logical", "description": "Automatically withdrawing funds without user delay (EFF-05) may conflict with the safe notification process outlined in SAF-03."}], "positions": [{"id": "EFF-04", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "drop since it overlaps with SAF-01"}, {"id": "TRU-04", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "drop since it overlaps with SAF-01"}, {"id": "RES-03", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "drop since it overlaps with SAF-01"}, {"id": "EFF-05", "stance": "modify", "proposal": "ensure user notification before automatic withdrawal to align with SAF-03"}], "concessions": [], "agree_to_close": false}

[Round 1] EfficiencyAgent: Performance efficiency is critical for a seamless user experience in the ATM system. Requirements EFF-01 and EFF-02 ensure that transactions are processed quickly and that the system can handle high volumes. EFF-03 focuses on optimizing data retrieval, which is essential for minimizing latency when accessing transaction history. EFF-04, while overlapping with SAF-01, emphasizes the importance of maintaining performance standards under operational constraints. EFF-05 is vital for user satisfaction, and EFF-06 ensures immediate feedback, which is necessary for effective user interaction. Lastly, EFF-07 addresses the system's capacity to manage requests efficiently, preventing overloads.
{"conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["SAF-01", "EFF-04"], "type": "redundant", "description": "Both requirements aim to prevent negative balances, causing redundancy."}, {"ids": ["SAF-02", "EFF-05"], "type": "logical", "description": "Automatically withdrawing funds without user delay (EFF-05) may conflict with the notification process in SAF-03."}], "positions": [{"id": "SAF-01", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "drop due to redundancy with EFF-04"}, {"id": "EFF-04", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "retain as it emphasizes performance standards"}, {"id": "SAF-02", "stance": "modify", "proposal": "ensure user notification aligns with EFF-05"}], "concessions": [], "agree_to_close": false}

[Round 1] ResponsibilityAgent: Ethical compliance is essential for the ATM system to ensure it operates within legal frameworks and safeguards user interests. Requirement RES-01 ensures adherence to financial regulations, while RES-02 guarantees accountability through comprehensive transaction logs. RES-03 prevents users from incurring negative balances, protecting financial integrity. RES-04 reinforces secure user authentication, which is critical for fairness. RES-05 and RES-06 are vital for ensuring responsible fund management and immediate user notifications regarding insufficient funds. Lastly, RES-07 emphasizes the importance of maintaining user privacy, aligning with ethical standards.
{"conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["SAF-01", "EFF-04", "TRU-04"], "type": "redundant", "description": "Requirements SAF-01, EFF-04, and TRU-04 redundantly aim to prevent negative balances, which overlaps with RES-03."}, {"ids": ["SAF-02", "EFF-05"], "type": "logical", "description": "Automatically withdrawing funds without user delay in EFF-05 could conflict with the need for user notification in RES-06."}], "positions": [{"id": "SAF-01", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "drop due to redundancy with RES-03"}, {"id": "EFF-04", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "drop due to redundancy with RES-03"}, {"id": "TRU-04", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "drop due to redundancy with RES-03"}, {"id": "SAF-02", "stance": "modify", "proposal": "ensure user notification aligns with RES-06"}], "concessions": [], "agree_to_close": false}

[Round 1] GreenAgent: Sustainability is crucial for the ATM system to minimize environmental impact. Requirement GRN-01 ensures energy efficiency by optimizing transaction processing, while GRN-02 addresses the carbon footprint by providing transaction-specific reports. GRN-03 emphasizes using energy-efficient hardware, supporting long-term sustainability. GRN-04 focuses on minimizing data storage needs, thus reducing resource consumption. GRN-05 promotes electronic records to cut down paper use, enhancing eco-friendliness. GRN-06 ensures the system conserves energy during inactivity, and GRN-07 commits to evaluating environmental impact annually. These requirements collectively contribute to a greener ATM operation, aligning with modern sustainability goals.
{"conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["EFF-01", "GRN-01"], "type": "resource", "description": "Optimizing for energy efficiency (GRN-01) may conflict with the need for rapid transaction processing (EFF-01) if not carefully managed."}, {"ids": ["EFF-04", "GRN-04"], "type": "logical", "description": "Minimizing data storage (GRN-04) may conflict with the need for comprehensive transaction logs required for performance (EFF-04)."}], "positions": [{"id": "GRN-01", "stance": "support", "proposal": ""}, {"id": "GRN-02", "stance": "support", "proposal": ""}, {"id": "GRN-03", "stance": "support", "proposal": ""}, {"id": "GRN-04", "stance": "support", "proposal": ""}, {"id": "GRN-05", "stance": "support", "proposal": ""}, {"id": "GRN-06", "stance": "support", "proposal": ""}, {"id": "GRN-07", "stance": "support", "proposal": ""}], "concessions": [], "agree_to_close": false}

[Round 1] TrustworthinessAgent: Ensuring the security and privacy of user data is paramount in the ATM system. Requirement TRU-01 mandates encryption of transactions during transmission, safeguarding sensitive information. TRU-02 reinforces the necessity of secure PIN-based authentication to prevent unauthorized access. TRU-03 ensures comprehensive transaction logging for accountability and audit purposes. TRU-04 prevents transactions that could lead to negative balances, aligning with user protection. TRU-05 allows users to securely review their transaction history, enhancing transparency. TRU-06 provides immediate notifications of insufficient funds, protecting users from unexpected overdrafts. Lastly, TRU-07 ensures data integrity, validating account operations against established rules. These requirements collectively uphold user trust and regulatory compliance.
{"conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["SAF-01", "EFF-04", "RES-03"], "type": "redundant", "description": "Requirements SAF-01, EFF-04, and RES-03 aim to prevent negative balances, overlapping with TRU-04."}, {"ids": ["SAF-02", "EFF-05"], "type": "logical", "description": "Automatically withdrawing funds without user notification (EFF-05) could conflict with the need for secure user communication in TRU-06."}], "positions": [{"id": "SAF-01", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "drop due to redundancy with TRU-04"}, {"id": "EFF-04", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "drop due to redundancy with TRU-04"}, {"id": "RES-03", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "drop due to redundancy with TRU-04"}, {"id": "SAF-02", "stance": "modify", "proposal": "ensure user notification aligns with TRU-06"}], "concessions": [], "agree_to_close": false}

[Round 2] SafetyAgent: Safety remains a top priority in our ATM system. I maintain support for requirements SAF-01, SAF-02, SAF-04, and SAF-05 as they ensure user protection and accountability. However, I acknowledge the redundancy in SAF-01 with EFF-04, RES-03, and TRU-04; thus I am willing to drop SAF-01 to streamline requirements. I propose modifying SAF-02 to ensure user notification aligns with EFF-05 and TRU-06 to maintain a balance between safety and efficiency. I oppose the dropping of SAF-03, SAF-04, SAF-06, and SAF-07 as they are critical for operational safety and reliability.
{"conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["EFF-04", "RES-03", "TRU-04"], "type": "redundant", "description": "These requirements overlap with SAF-01, which I propose to drop."}, {"ids": ["EFF-05", "TRU-06"], "type": "logical", "description": "User notification is critical before withdrawal; I propose modifying SAF-02 to ensure this."}], "positions": [{"id": "SAF-01", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "drop due to redundancy with EFF-04, RES-03, and TRU-04"}, {"id": "SAF-02", "stance": "modify", "proposal": "ensure user notification aligns with EFF-05 and TRU-06"}, {"id": "SAF-03", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": ""}, {"id": "SAF-04", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": ""}, {"id": "SAF-05", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": ""}, {"id": "SAF-06", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": ""}, {"id": "SAF-07", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": ""}], "concessions": ["SAF-01"], "agree_to_close": false}

YOUR TURN. You are EfficiencyAgent. Your quality dimension is Performance Efficiency: resource optimization, latency, throughput, responsiveness.
Your own requirements are EFF-01, EFF-02, EFF-03, EFF-04, EFF-05, EFF-06, EFF-07. This is round 2 of at most 3.
Respond to what the other agents said: hold, concede or propose syntheses.
Answer with the JSON object only.
